items.title: Jean Bach interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, October 18, 1995
items.q: but you remember Benny Powell, he played trombone with Basie.

ctx.x: Well, Milt would need a van.

Can you believe it? I wonder what he’s got? And maybe that basement would yield some — but you remember Benny Powell, he played trombone with Basie. His then-wife, I think they’re not together now, called me up one day and said that she was trying to get some sort of a wive’s mafia going, ‘cause she figured wives saved snapshots and she was going to get in touch with a lot of wives. And that would have been a nice little archive, if she’d ever followed through. So I guess when she and Benny broke up that was the…
Well this has been a fascinating conversation.
